messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> @oncall-eng @billing-sig: Billing/ingest anomaly detected for ingestion-aggregator. Sudden +450% token_count spike for a small customer cohort starting 2026-03-14T16:10Z. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/billing-ingest-anomaly

alex: oncall here, seeing alerts. Confirming scope: which customers affected?

maria: I can see cust_ids 4321, 8765, 9920 spiking. Spike aligns with a router-v2 rollout ~16:00Z.

kevin: router-v2 rollout (hashing change) went to prod 16:05Z in us-west-2. Rolling back now?

jia: pulling logs from ingest-aggregator, tailing 100 lines...

jia: ```
2026-03-14T16:09:37Z ERROR aggregator: duplicate_event detected, incoming_id mismatch: "req_abc123" vs "req_abc123:variant"
2026-03-14T16:09:38Z WARN kvcache: cache_miss for key prefix_hash=0x7f3a
2026-03-14T16:09:39Z INFO batcher: batch_size=256 tokens=49120
```

alex: hmm duplicate_event + changed request id token. router-v2 added model_variant suffix to request_id to improve routing. That might break dedupe keys downstream.

samir: if dedupe uses raw request_id and router changed it, same request could be ingested twice under different ids -> double-count tokens.

maria: confirmed: aggregator dedupe_key = request_id (legacy). router-v2 now appends ":variant" to request_id for some traffic. So same original request hashed differently.

kevin: mitigation options: 1) rollback router-v2 2) patch aggregator to normalize request_id (strip variant) 3) pause billing export. Which do we want first?

alex: Rollback first to stop ongoing duplication. Then patch aggregator to handle both forms. Also pause billing exports to avoid customer overages while we reconcile.

kevin: executing: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/router-v2`

kevin: ```
deployment.apps/router-v2 "router-v2" rolled back
status: rollout complete
```

incident-bot: NOTE: rollback action recorded. Pager remains open until counts return to baseline.

jia: deploying temporary aggregator normalization: strip suffix regex /:variant$/ from request_id at ingestion stage. Patching now.

jia: ```
patch applied: aggregator-config:dedupe_normalizer = "s/:variant$//"
restarted pod aggregator-78f9
```

maria: pausing billing export to downstream billing pipeline (etl-billing) and creating backup of latest window. `etl-billing.pause=true` set.

samir: starting a reconciliation job to identify duplicated records in the last 2 hours (group by original_fingerprint). Query in data-warehouse:```
SELECT fingerprint, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM ingest_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-14T15:50:00Z'
GROUP BY fingerprint
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY tokens_sum DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

alex: good. Support: please draft customer communications. Likely impact: a handful of customers got temporary overage flags and automated invoices may have been generated. We need to revoke/credit before billing cycle closes.

billing-sig: we've been paged. Standby while we check invoice generation. If exports were paused in time maybe only flags, not final invoices.

kevin: post-patch metrics: token_count spike dropping. Sending aggregated counts: before rollback: +470% for affected cohort; 10m after rollback: +5% then normalizing.

maria: confirmed ingest duplicates decreasing to 0 duplicates in last 10m window. Billing export paused successfully.

alex: assigning follow-ups: maria -> support ticket + customer comms; kevin -> postmortem + fix to router request id change process; jia -> permanent aggregator dedupe normalization and test coverage. I'll file a tracking ticket and link here.

alex: ticket: https://redwood/ops/ISSUE-2026 (created) — please add owner comments.

maria: support message draft to customers: "We detected a brief duplication of usage leading to temporary overage flags for a small number of accounts at ~16:05Z. We paused billing exports, reversed duplicate counts, and will apply credits where invoices were generated. Sorry for the noise — we'll follow up with details."

billing-sig: action: freeze any auto-invoicing for affected accounts until reconciliation completes. Also request finance to hold charges.

samir: reconciliation job results: 78 duplicated fingerprints, total duplicated tokens = 1,240,160 across 3 customers. Will prepare credit amounts.

jia: pushing permanent fix to main: normalizer applied at ingress + unit tests for request id variants. PR: https://redwood/pr/4218

kevin: I'll add a checklist to deployment runbooks: if request_id format changes, confirm dedupe key compatibility w/ aggregator and billing.

alex: good work. Closing pager once we've validated billing export stays paused and reconciliation queued. Will follow up with postmortem.

maria: closing notes: metrics back to baseline by 16:25Z. Customer comms sent to affected accounts, support ticket created CUST-9981.

incident-bot: Pager closed by alex at 2026-03-14T16:41:03Z. Postmortem required: severity P2.

alex: postmortem owners: kevin (root cause & process), jia (code fix), maria (customer impact & credits). Target: initial draft in 48h.

maria: adding estimated credit amounts to support ticket and notifying finance.

kevin: note for follow-up: investigate long-tail risk: other services reading request_id may also see format change; schedule quick sweep next deploy window.

alex: thanks everyone. Wrap up here. :thumbsup:
